questions.explanation: Area of parallelogram = base × height = 15 × 8 = 120 m². (Not ½ × base × height — that's the triangle.)

questions.question: Perimeter of an equilateral triangle with side 17 cm =
questions.explanation: Equilateral triangle: all 3 sides equal. P = 3 × 17 = 51 cm.

questions.question: A rhombus has diagonals of 16 cm and 12 cm. Area =
questions.explanation: Area of rhombus = ½ × d₁ × d₂ = ½ × 16 × 12 = 96 cm².

questions.question: An L-shaped figure: a 10×8 m rectangle with a 4×3 m piece removed from one corner. Area =
questions.explanation: Full rectangle = 10×8 = 80 m². Removed piece = 4×3 = 12 m². L-shape area = 80 − 12 = 68 m².

A rectangular swimming pool is 40 m × 25 m. A path 2 m wide runs inside the pool's edge for safety. Area of the swimming zone =
questions.explanation: Inner swimming zone: (40−4) × (25−4) = 36 × 21 = 756 m². (Subtract 2 m path from each side: 2×2=4 from each dimension.)

questions.question: A rectangular plot (30 m × 20 m) has a path 2.5 m wide running around the OUTSIDE. Area of path only =
questions.explanation: Outer dimensions: (30+5) × (20+5) = 35 × 25 = 875 m². Inner plot = 30×20 = 600 m². Path = 875 − 600 = 275 m².

questions.question: A rectangular field 120 m × 90 m. A farmer walks along the diagonal (use: diagonal² = l² + b²). Which is closest to the diagonal length?
questions.explanation: Diagonal² = 120² + 90² = 14,400 + 8,100 = 22,500. Diagonal = √22,500 = 150 m. (Pythagorean triple: 90-120-150 = 3-4-5 scaled by 30.)

questions.question: A playground has a rectangular section (50 m × 30 m) and a triangular section attached to one end (base 30 m, height 20 m). Total area =
questions.explanation: Rectangle = 50×30 = 1,500 m². Triangle = ½×30×20 = 300 m². Total = 1,500 + 300 = 1,800 m².

questions.question: Rectangle A: 36 m × 25 m. Rectangle B: 45 m × 20 m. Which has greater perimeter?
questions.explanation: P(A) = 2(36+25) = 2×61 = 122 m. P(B) = 2(45+20) = 2×65 = 130 m. B has the greater perimeter (130 m > 122 m). Note: area(A) = 36×25 = 900 m² = area(B) = 45×20 = 900 m² — same area but different perimeters!

questions.explanation: Area of kite = ½ × d₁ × d₂ = ½ × 24 × 10 = 120 cm². (Same formula as rhombus.)
